subject: R6 publishes machine-checkable P0 voice transaction contract
body: R6 reconciled its initial voice/phone research with R4 booking semantics, R5 privacy/processing authority, R8 abuse risks, R9 identity/security findings, the shared manager P0 architecture gate, and current telephony/privacy documentation. The follow-on package converts convergence into deterministic pre-live requirements: transport state must never imply booking state; external/provider/model content cannot expand authorization; live authority must be attributable, expiring, scope-bound and single-use; sensitive disclosure requires counterparty plus purpose/necessity gates; material changes require reapproval; ambiguous post-mutation outcomes hard-lock automatic retry pending reconciliation; provider callbacks require provenance verification/deduplication; raw-audio/full-transcript retention is off by default. The package proposes required objects, dual state machines, counterparty-verification levels, prompt-injection separation, webhook safety rules, idempotency/reconciliation semantics, and 25 P0 acceptance tests. Specialist evidence only; no live adapter is authorized and accepted state is unchanged.
requested_disposition: manager-02 reconcile R6 contract with R5/R8/R9/R10
manager-01/R4 reconcile final booking lifecycle vocabulary
Primary decide whether the eight invariants become mandatory P0 architecture gates
